summary: Permissions request: Support/CS access to internal-only model changelog + audit views (Console Admin + API)
description:
Requester(s): Support + Customer Success
- Dev Patel (Support escalation/workflow)
- Miguel Santos (Enterprise CS)

Business need:
Support and CS need access to INTERNAL-ONLY model changelog and audit history to resolve escalations where customers report output drift / unexpected behavior and we must answer: what changed, when, and who/what promoted it.

Current problem:
- Console customer-facing release notes intentionally redact internal fields.
- Support currently relies on ad-hoc Eng lookups or screenshots.
- Recent incidents/tickets (e.g., SUP-28429 output regression; SUP-28411 missing release notes) require faster, self-serve visibility.

Requested access scope (internal-only):
1) Console Admin UI: per-model change history with internal notes, event payload details, and audit event IDs.
2) Internal API endpoints: query changelog/audit by model_id, model_version, deployment mode, region, and time range.
3) Ability to export a redacted-for-customer snippet (public view) + an internal evidence bundle (audit IDs, event hashes) for escalations.

Constraints:
- Must not expand access to edit/promote model metadata.
- Must be least-privilege and fully audited (who accessed what, when).
- Must not re-introduce the prior bug where internal notes rendered to non-admins (see PR-18463).

Proposed approach:
- Add a dedicated RBAC permission set: "model_changelog:read_internal" and "model_audit:read".
- Create Okta group "support-model-changelog-admin" mapped to that permission set.
- Restrict access to Support Engineering + designated CS/TAM leads only (time-bound approvals).
- Enable audit logging for all admin-changelog reads (query logs) with retention aligned to Security guidance.

Requested approvers:
- Naomi Feldman (Security/Compliance stakeholder)
- Marcus Lin (Security engineering reviewer)
- Dylan Brooks / Chloe Martin (Console & Tooling ownership)

Acceptance criteria:
- Support can view internal-only changelog/audit in Console without elevated "super-admin".
- Access is read-only and does not allow metadata edits/promotions.
- All access is logged and searchable for compliance.
- Documentation exists for requesting/removing access and for handling customer escalations.
comments: 2025-10-10 09:14 Dev Patel (Reporter): Creating ticket after SUP-28429 escalation. We spent ~6 hours to identify the exact model version promotion + internal notes. Need a small set of Support/CS folks to see internal changelog/audit views so we can answer customers quickly and stop pulling Eng into every case.

2025-10-10 10:03 Miguel Santos (CS): +1. For enterprise accounts we often need to provide an evidence trail (what changed, when, rollback path). Public release notes are necessary but not sufficient. We need internal view + audit event IDs for our internal case files.

2025-10-11 13:22 Chloe Martin (Console Backend EM): Agree on read-only access. Please ensure we don't conflate with the customer-visible release notes feed. We need explicit RBAC checks server-side + UI guards (we already have tests after PR-18463).

2025-10-11 14:05 Marcus Lin (Security Eng Reviewer): Approved in principle with conditions: (1) least-privilege role separated from existing admin roles, (2) mandatory audit logs on read access (query-level), (3) time-bound access for CS unless explicitly justified, (4) no access to internal notes export endpoints without redaction guardrails.

2025-10-12 09:40 Naomi Feldman (Security/Compliance): Approval granted provided retention for access logs meets enterprise expectations and we document access request/revocation. Also ensure this does not change what is published publicly (no new fields).

2025-10-13 16:18 Svetlana Petrenko (Assignee): Plan: create Okta group + RBAC binding; implement permission checks on internal changelog endpoints; add audit log events for "admin_changelog_read" including actor, filters, and result count (no payload content). Will coordinate with Jada on endpoint enforcement and Leila on regression tests.

2025-10-15 11:07 Jada Williams (Staff Console): Implemented server-side gates for internal fields: if caller lacks model_changelog:read_internal, response omits internal_notes, raw_event_payload, and audit_event_ids. UI only renders internal tab when permission present. Added test coverage for role matrix.

2025-10-16 08:55 Connor O'Brien (Release Eng): Please add this role to our release-note preview workflow docs. Reviewers sometimes ask Support to validate notes; Support should be able to see internal deltas without needing repo access.

resolution: Created dedicated read-only RBAC role for internal model changelog/audit visibility; mapped to Okta group support-model-changelog-admin with time-bound CS memberships; enforced server-side redaction for non-authorized callers; enabled audited logging of admin-changelog reads; documented request/revocation process for Support/CS.
